headline: Figma Shares Fall as Expenses for AI Features Weigh on Sentiment
summary: Figma's investments in AI models and agents are driving user engagement, but high operational costs for delivering these features are raising concern among investors.
why: Figma is a cloud-based design and user-interface platform widely used by software development teams.

impacts.name: Figma
impacts.why: Increased infrastructure and compute costs for AI features weighed on profitability expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Figma's stock fell as investors focused on the high infrastructure costs required to deliver its AI capabilities despite solid usage growth.
